field.label: Log type
field.help: Where query logs are written. Disabled (the default) turns query logging off; Console writes each query to the Blocky log (viewable under Log File); CSV and CSV per-client write daily .csv files to the Target directory; SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL and TimescaleDB write to a database using the connection string in Target; dnstap streams to the dnstap socket set in Target. Console is high-volume (one line per query); use CSV or a database for long-term logs.

field.label: Target
field.help: Where the log goes, by type. CSV: an existing directory under /var, not a file name; Blocky writes 2026-09-14_ALL.log per day, or one file per client. SQLite: a file path under /var, created with its parent, on local storage only. MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB: a connection string, e.g. postgres://user:password@host:5432/blocky. dnstap: unix:/var/run/dnstap.sock, tcp://127.0.0.1:6000, or a bare socket path. Unused for Console. A file:/path value reads the target from that file, keeping credentials out of the configuration, but not for SQLite, where the prefix is taken literally.

field.label: Retention (days)
field.help: Delete query logs older than this many days. 0 keeps them indefinitely. Applies to CSV and the database types; dnstap streams rather than stores.

field.label: Logged fields
field.help: Which fields to record per query. Leave empty to log all fields. Not used by dnstap, which exports the full DNS messages, and log privacy does not obfuscate those payloads.

field.label: Flush interval
field.help: How often buffered entries are written to the target. Used by the database types and dnstap; CSV writes each entry as it arrives.

field.label: Creation attempts
field.help: Number of attempts to open the log target (file or database) before giving up.

field.label: Creation cooldown
field.help: Wait time between attempts to open the log target.

field.label: Ignore SUDN queries
field.help: Do not log queries answered as Special Use Domain Names (SUDN).

field.label: Ignore domains
field.help: Domains excluded from the query log. Each entry matches the query name as an exact domain, a *.wildcard, or a /regex/.
